title: What is React?
answers: React is a JavaScript library for building user interfaces.
It allows developers to create reusable components.

title: What is JSX?
description: Explain the purpose and usage of JSX in React.
answers: It allows developers to write HTML elements in JavaScript code.

title: What are React Hooks?
description: Describe the purpose and benefits of React Hooks.
answers: React Hooks are functions that let you use state and other React features without writing a class.

title: What is Java?
description: Explain the basics of Java programming.
answers: Java is a high-level, object-oriented programming language.
It is platform-independent due to its 'write once, run anywhere' philosophy.

title: What is Python?
description: Explain the fundamentals of Python programming.
answers: Python is an interpreted, high-level programming language.
It is known for its simplicity and readability.

title: What is JavaScript?
description: Explain the basics of JavaScript programming.
answers: JavaScript is a lightweight, interpreted programming language.
It is primarily used for web development to make websites interactive.

title: What is the use of classes in Java?
description: Describe the purpose and benefits of classes in Java.
answers: Classes in Java are blueprints for creating objects.
They define the properties and behaviors of an object.

title: What are Python data types?
description: Describe common data types used in Python.
answers: Common Python data types include int, float, str, list, tuple, dict, and set.
They represent numbers, text, collections, and other data structures.

title: What is the role of JavaScript in web development?
description: Describe how JavaScript enhances web development.
answers: JavaScript adds interactivity and dynamic behavior to web pages.
It allows developers to create features like animations, form validation, and event handling.
